name: An agent's scopes are kept on the agent; a new credential carries exactly them
summary: Stored scopes govern renewal; dead or wider credentials cannot reset them. Only the owner confirms inferred/unknown scopes; non-owner lists refuse 403 and plain renewal 409 asks for the owner. Confirmed scopes can be narrowed by an authorized account, widened only by the owner. Reads never confirm. Credentials retain at most 20 working/newest 5 dead records. One issue/first-revoke audit records IDs, actor/account/request/time and scopes/source before/after; no labels/secrets/hashes/paths. Audit shares the 10,000-entry tail. Credential state saves before its replay receipt. Failed issue save rolls back issuance; failed revoke save keeps access revoked in memory pending a successful save. Redundant revoke retains the route save and keyed receipt without duplicate audit. Crash/receipt failure can leave 409 in-progress. Project confirmation and its registration mark also save before receipt; ordinary routes otherwise retain their retry contract. The page distinguishes inferred from confirmed scopes and pages 20 filtered cards. This carrier is an unaccepted proposal.
